```markdown
# 📦 O&M Handoff: Telemetry Ingestion Pipeline

## 🛠️ Monitoring & Observability
- **Flink Dashboard**: [https://console.cloud.google.com/dataflow/pipelines?project=telemetry-prod](https://console.cloud.google.com/dataflow/pipelines?project=telemetry-prod)
- **Cloud Logging (Logs Explorer)**: [https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/view/logs-explorer](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/view/logs-explorer)
- **Health Check Function**: `health-check-worker` (triggered daily at 00:00 UTC)

## 📚 Runbook: Incident Response – Ingestion Failure
1. **Check Flink Dashboard** for active job failures or lag.
2. **Inspect Cloud Logging** for `ERROR` entries tagged with `ingest_pipeline`.
3. **Verify Kafka consumer lag** via `kafka-consumer-groups.sh`.
4. **Trigger manual retry** using Cloud Function: `retry-ingest-job`.
5. **Escalate to pipeline owners** if unresolved after 15 min.

## 👥 Contact Information
- **Pipeline Owner**: Jane Doe (jane.doe@company.com)
- **SRE On-Call**: SRE Team (sre-team@company.com)
- **Jira Ticket**: [INGEST-001](https://jira.company.com/browse/INGEST-001) (Open – awaiting SRE sign-off)

> ⚠️ Do not close Jira ticket without explicit SRE approval.
```

✅ **Documentation updated and committed to `handoff/README.md`**
